create_MultiplayerTrackingCamera: create a MultiplayerTrackingCamera instance with min_distance, distance_factor, and smoothing_update_speed parameters
render_camera_frame: render the current camera frame after physics has been compiled and camera initialized
initialize_camera_episode: initialize the camera to its target pose using entity positions at episode start
update_camera_after_step: smoothly move the camera toward its target pose after each physics step
compute_target_camera_pose: compute the target camera pose from entity positions using centroid and max radius
